summary: This directory serves as the root entry point for the approval workflow system. It provides a unified, structured interface that aggregates domain models, input command schemas, core service logic, and system-level ports, ensuring consistent access to the entire package's functionality.
responsibilities: Expose core approval workflow components to external consumers
Centralize access to domain models, service operations, and system interfaces
Maintain a clean and consistent package API surface
relationships: The root index aggregates domain models and service logic to provide a cohesive entry point for consumers.
Input command schemas and system ports are exposed alongside service definitions to facilitate complete integration with the approval workflow.
designDecisions: Centralized barrel file exports for unified package access
Strict separation between commands, models, policies, ports, and services
Encapsulation of sub-module details to preserve clean external API boundaries
